title: Accessibility tree pruning and completion checks

claims.text: prune walks from roots in document order with an explicit stack, keeping only non-ignored nodes whose role is in CHASSIS_ROLES and emitting role, normalized name, state attrs, depth, ancestors, node_id and backend_id; OPAQUE_ROLES (article) stops descent into children.
normalize_name collapses whitespace via NFC, escapes backslash and pipe, and truncates to MAX_NAME_BYTES (64) bytes without ending on a lone backslash.

violations checks the pruned projection for an empty tree, a missing ready status, progressbars after ready, duplicate or invalid actionable names, a missing current navigation link, missing banner/navigation/main/contentinfo landmarks, and an unnamed main screen.

decision.rule: Change here when the pruned accessibility projection, name normalization, canonical tree hash, or violation checks need to change.
decision.failure: A ready screen reports missing landmarks or duplicate actions, or the tree hash changes without any role/name/state change.

questions.q: Where does prune decide which roles descend and which articles are opaque?
Where should I change how normalize_name bounds serialized names to 64 bytes?
Where can I debug why violations reports progress_after_ready or duplicate_action?
